text:
Maria Lopez: Heads-up — can we slot the cherrypick + infra toggle for widget-v2 into the 14:30 release train? Needs a smoke owner and a rollback owner. ETA ~20m. @Jamie Chen @Akhil Patel
Jamie Chen: I can take smoke if there are no DB schema changes. I'll run the quick health scripts and watch logs. :thumbsup:
Akhil Patel: I'll be rollback owner. I have the rollback image staged and the revert runbook ready.
Tzvi Cohen: I'll validate canary routing after deploy (check /canary header). If anything odd, I'll flip traffic back.
sre-oncall: I'm around 14:15-15:00 and can help with infra-side checks — let me know if you need kernel/driver checks on the dedicated GPUs.
Maria Lopez: no DB migration, just config + new weights. Jamie, can you call out the smoke checklist here?
Jamie Chen: Quick smoke checklist:
• hit /health and /ready on pods
• sample prompt throughput check (3 requests)
• check latencies in datadog dashboard `infra.latency.widget-v2`
• sanity-check embeddings endpoint (1 sample)

Akhil Patel: Rollback steps (short):
```
# revert to previous tag
kubectl set image deploy/widget widget=image:20260211-abc123 -n prod
# or use rollout undo if needed
kubectl rollout undo deployment/widget -n prod
```
Also keep `--record` on new deploy so we can audit.
Maria Lopez: Deploy bot, can you reserve the 14:30 slot and annotate the train manifest?
deploy-bot: Reserved 14:30 slot for `widget-v2` on release-train-14. Entry added to train manifest: `widget-v2 (cherry-pick, infra-toggle)`. ETA 20m window.
Tzvi Cohen: One more ask — can we set a conservative canary size (5%) and auto-fallback to previous variant if error-rate > 1% for 2m?
Jamie Chen: yep, I'll set canary=5% and the auto-fallback policy. Adding the rule to the release config now.
Maria Lopez: Thanks. @sre-oncall if you see any infra noise I can pause the train.
sre-oncall: Roger. I'll post if I see GPU OOMs or unexpected pod churn.
Akhil Patel: After deploy, I'll run the revert dry-run locally and mark rollback-ready. Will post the commit hash and image id here.
Jamie Chen: PR merged, CI green. Triggering the gate at 14:28 for handoff.
Maria Lopez: ok handoff at 14:28, deploy at 14:30, smoke run 14:31-14:40, handback by 14:45 latest.
Tzvi Cohen: I'll flag in datadog dashboards and watch traces. Ping me if you need me to flip traffic.
deploy-bot: Gate opened at 1718804568 by Jamie Chen. Good luck! :partyparrot:
Akhil Patel: Rollback dry-run complete, image image:20260211-abc123 available.
Jamie Chen: Smoke started — health ok, sample prompts returning expected tokens, latency within SLO.
Maria Lopez: :tada: Looks green from product side. Handing back to release train at 14:44.
sre-oncall: Observability looks clean. No infra alerts.
Maria Lopez: Closing thread — thanks everyone. I'll update the train notes with the final image and tags. :memo:
